questions.question_text: Ram has an important office meeting to attend. If he travels from his home with 24km/h, he will reach the office 20 minutes late. He starts travelling with 36 km/h. After 30 minutes, he realises that he is going to reach office early by 10 minutes. By what value in km/h should he slow down his speed to reach the office on time?
questions.solution_text:
Assuming the distance = d and the time such that Ram reaches the office at correct time = t
If he travels with 24 km/h, then
$\ \frac{\ d}{24}=t+\ \frac{\ 20}{60}$
=> $\ \frac{\ d}{24}=t+\ \frac{\ 1}{3}$ ..........(1)
If he travels with 36 km/h,
$\ \frac{\ d}{36}=t-\frac{\ 1}{6}$ ......(2)
Subtracting (2) from (1),
$\ \frac{\ d}{24}\ -\ \frac{\ d}{36}=\ \frac{\ 1}{2}$
=> d=36 km
Putting d=36 in (2), we get t = $\ \frac{\ 7}{6}\ hours$ = 70 minutes
After travelling 30 minutes, he has already travelled $\ 36\times\ \frac{\ 30}{60}$ = 18 km
Distance left = 36-18=18 km, Time left = 70-30 = 40 minutes
Hence the speed = $\ \frac{\ 18}{40}\times\ 60$ = 27 km/h
So he to slow by 36-27 = 9 km/h

questions.question_text: Janaki starts walking from her school such that she takes a total of 4 steps of equal lengths. She takes each step in any one of the four directions i.e. East, West, North and South. What is the total number of ways in which Janaki will be back at her starting point (school) after completing the above-mentioned operation?
questions.solution_text:
To ensure that Janaki ends up at the same location as her starting point after taking 4 steps in each direction, we have the following:
Case 1: Take 2 steps in North and 2 steps in South direction
Total arrangements =$\frac{4!}{2!*2!}$ = 6
Case 2: Take 2 steps in East and 2 steps in the West direction 
Total arrangements =$\frac{4!}{2!*2!}$ = 6
Case 3: Take a step in each of the four directions
Total arrangements = 4! = 24
Total number of ways in which Janaki can reach her school after completing 6+6+24 = 36
36 is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: 210 men working at 90% efficiency are equivalent to 2 machines working at 75% efficiency. If 3 machines and 122 men can finish a piece of work in 30 days, in how many days can 10 men finish the piece of work working at 125% efficiency?
questions.solution_text:
210 x 9/10 men = 2 x 3/4 machines
189 men = 1.5 machines
126 men = 1 machine
Hence, ( 3 machines + 122 men ) x 30 = (3 x 126 + 122 ) = 15000 man hours.
Hence 10 men at 125% efficiency is equal to 12.5 men.
15000/12.5 = 1200 days.

questions.question_text: A shopkeeper sells two boxes of apples at the same price. If one of the boxes he gets a loss of 10% and on the other a profit of x%. Finally he realised that he neither made a profit nor loss on selling the boxes of apples. What is the value of x
questions.solution_text:
Let the selling price be S
One of the boxes he sold at a loss of 10% and the other at a profit of x%
Let us first try to find the CP, say C
$\frac{C - S}{C}$ = 0.1
0.9C = S 
C = $\frac{S}{0.9}$
$\frac{S - C}{C}$ = $\frac{x}{100}$
100S - 100C = xC
C = $\frac{100S}{x+100}$
Since he neither made a profit nor loss during this transaction
C.P1 - S.P1 = S.P2 - C.P2
$\frac{S}{0.9}-S\ =\ S\ -\frac{100S}{x+100}$
$\frac{S}{0.9}$ * 0.1 = $\frac{S}{100+x}$ * x
$\frac{1}{9}$ = $\frac{x}{100+x}$
x = 12.5%
A is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: A and B work for a professional graphic artist. They got an order of painting and doing calligraphy on 200 cards. They were paid ₹200/card. A worked on the cards for the first 2 days and B worked on it for the next 4 days. Remaining work they finished together in 2 days. If the efficiency of A is 33.33% more than that of B, how much money did A earn from this job ?
questions.solution_text:
Let the work done per day by B be $x$ units 
Thus, work done per day by A = $\dfrac{4x}{3}$ units 
Total work $t_w$ = [(Work done by A)x(2+2)]+[(Work done by B)x(4+2)] 
$ \Rightarrow t_w = [\dfrac{4x}{3} \times 4]+[x \times 6] $ 
$ \Rightarrow t_w = \dfrac{16x}{3} + 6x $ 
$ \Rightarrow t_w = \dfrac{34x}{3} $ units 
Work done by A, $w_1 = \dfrac{4x}{3} \times 4 = \dfrac{16x}{3} $ 
Amount earned by A, $a = \dfrac{\frac{16x}{3}}{\frac{34x}{3}} \times 40000 $ 
$ \Rightarrow a = \dfrac{320000}{17} \approx ₹18823.53$

questions.question_text: What is the sum of the last two digits of $\frac{6^{100}-1}{5}$?
questions.solution_text:
$\frac{6^{100}-1}{5}=\frac{\left(6-1\right)\left(1+6+6^2+6^3+....+6^{99}\right)}{5}$
Therefore, the expression reduces to $ \left(1+6+6^2+6^3+....+6^{99}\right)$
The last two digits will be obtained when the expression is divided by 100. We can write 100 as the product of two coprimes in the following manner: $100=4\times\ 25$  [$N=a\times\ b$; where $a=4 , b=25$ are co-primes]
Using Chinese remainder theorem:
$\left(1+6+6^2+6^3+....+6^{99}\right)\ mod\ 4=r_1=3$
$\left(1+6+6^2+6^3+....+6_{ }^{99}\right)\ mod\ 25=r_2=0$
$r=ax\left(r_2\right)+by\left(r_1\right)$; solving $ax+by=1--->4x+25y=1$, we obtain $y=1$ for $x=-6$  
Substituting all the above values, we get $r=75$
The sum of the last two digits = (7 + 5) = 12

questions.question_text: What is the radius of the sphere described by the curve: $x^2+y^2+z^2-4x+2y-6z=22$
questions.solution_text:
The given equation $x^2+y^2+z^2-4x+2y-6z=22$ can be rephrased as:
$x^2-4x+4+y^2+2y+1+z^2-6z+9=22+4+1+9$
=>$\left(x-2\right)^2+\left(y+1\right)^2+\left(z-3\right)^2=36$
So, for the equation $\left(x-2\right)^2+\left(y+1\right)^2+\left(z-3\right)^2=36$, which is of the form $\left(x-a\right)^2+\left(y-b\right)^2+\left(z-c\right)^2=r^2$, the centre is (a,b,c) or (2,-1,3) and $r^2$=36.
Therefore radius, r=6 units.

$\Rightarrow$ $\dfrac{11000 + x}{11000 + 3x}$
We can see that denominator is greater than numerator hence the ratio can’t be greater than 1.
In option c, we have the ratio = $\dfrac{6}{5}$ > 1 this is not possible. 
Hence, option C is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: If $x^2-2x-1=0$, then what is the value of $\left(x-2\right)^4+\frac{1}{\left(x-2\right)^4}$?
questions.solution_text:
$x^2-2x-1=0$ can be written as $x^2-4x+4\ +2x\ -\ 4\ =\ 1$
=> $\left(x-2\right)^2+2\left(x\ -\ 2\right)\ =\ 1$
=>$\left(x-2\right)\left[\left(x\ -\ 2\right)+2\right)\ =\ 1$
=> $\left(\left(x\ -\ 2\right)+2\right)\ =\ \frac{1}{x-2}$
=>$\left(x\ -\ 2\right)\ -\ \left(\frac{1}{x-2}\right)=-2$
Squarring on both sides
$\left(x\ -\ 2\right)^2\ +\ \left(\frac{1}{x-2}\right)^2-2=4$
$\left(x\ -\ 2\right)^2\ +\ \left(\frac{1}{x-2}\right)^2=6$
Squarring on both sides 
$\left(x\ -\ 2\right)^4\ +\ \left(\frac{1}{x-2}\right)^4+2=36$
$\left(x\ -\ 2\right)^4\ +\ \left(\frac{1}{x-2}\right)^4=34$

questions.question_text: In a shoe store, there are 15 pairs of highly expensive shoes. One night, a thief breaks in and steals 6 shoes, not necessarily having a matching pair with him. What is the probability that at least one matching pair of shoes was stolen by the thief?
questions.solution_text:
The probability that at least one matching pair of shoes was stolen by the thief will be the same as 1 - the probability of not getting any pair.
Hence, the required probability = $1 - \dfrac{30*28*26*24*22*20}{30*29*28*27*26*25}$
$\Rightarrow$ $\dfrac{29*27*25 - 24*22*20}{29*27*25 }$
$\Rightarrow$ $\dfrac{601}{1305}$
Therefore, option B is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: A shopkeeper buys the item from a wholesaler and marks up the price by 20%. A customer pays Rs 102 for it after getting a discount of 15%. What is the profit% of wholeseller if he incurred cost of Rs 80 to make the item

Let SP for wholeseller be Rs x. Then CP of shopkeeper = Rs x
Marked Price for the seller = Rs (1.2)*x
Selling Price = 1.2*0.85*x = 1.02x
Given that 1.02x = 102
Thus x =100
Profit = 100-80 = Rs 20
Profit% = $\frac{20}{80}\times\ 100\%\ =\ 25\%$

questions.question_text: Consider the following figure. It consists of an isosceles right angled triangle, around which a circle is circumscribed, the same circle is also the incircle of the outermost equilateral triangle. Find the ratio of areas of the inner triangle to the outer triangle.
questions.solution_text:
Let us assume that each side of the outermost triangle = a.
Since the circle is the incircle of the triangle, the radius = Inradius of the triangle = $\frac{a}{2\sqrt{\ 3}}$. [Since, inradius of an equilateral triangle of side a is $\frac{a}{2\sqrt{\ 3}}$]
The hypotenuse of the inner right-angled isosceles triangle is equal to the diameter of the circle, since it is circumscribing it.
Let the hypotenuse be of length h.
Therefore h = 2 x  Radius of circle = $\frac{2a}{2\sqrt{\ 3}}$ = $\frac{a}{\sqrt{\ 3}}$
Since it is an isosceles right angled triangle, let base and perpendicular both be equal to p.
$\therefore\ p^2+p^2=\left(\frac{a}{\sqrt{\ 3}}\right)^2$
$\therefore\ 2p^2=\frac{a^2}{3}\ \longrightarrow\ p^2=\frac{a^2}{6}$
Area of the inner triangle = 
$\frac{1}{2}\times\ base\times\ height=\ \frac{1}{2}p^2=\frac{a^2}{12}\ $
Area of the outermost equilateral triangle = $\frac{\sqrt{\ 3}}{4}side^2=\frac{\sqrt{\ 3}}{4}a^2$
Therefore, ratio of areas = $\frac{\frac{a^2}{12}\ }{\frac{\sqrt{\ 3}}{4}a^2}=\frac{1}{12}\times\ \frac{4}{\sqrt{\ 3}}=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{\ 3}}$

questions.question_text: If $log_742 = a$ , $log_730 = b$ and $log_728 = c$. What is value of $\log_{420}21$
questions.solution_text:
$\log_{420}21=\frac{\log_721}{\log_7420}$
$\implies$ $\frac{\log_721}{\log_7420}=\frac{1+\log_73}{\log_7\left(2^2\times\ 3\times\ 5\times\ 7\right)}$
$\implies$ $\frac{\log_721}{\log_7420}\ =\frac{1+\log_73}{2\log_72\ +\log_73+\ \log_75+1}$ ...(I)
Now we are given that 
$log_742 = a$, Thus $ 1 + log_72 + log_73 = a$ .....(II)
$log_730 = b$, Thus $log_72 + log_73 +log_75 = b$ ...(III)
$log_728 = c$, Thus, $ 1 + 2 log_72 = c$  $ log_72 = \frac{c-1}{2}$.(IV)
Putting value of $log_72$ from (IV) to (II) 
$1+\ \frac{c-1}{2}+\log_73\ =\ a$
$\log_73\ =\ \frac{2a-c-1}{2}$...(V)
Putting (III),(IV)and(V) in (I) we get
$\frac{\log_721}{\log_7420}\ =\frac{1+\log_73}{2\log_72\ +\log_73+\ \log_75+1}$  = $\frac{1+\frac{2a-c-1}{2}}{\frac{c-1}{2}+b+1}$
Mulltiplying and dividing by 2
$\frac{\log_721}{\log_7420}\ $ = $\frac{2a-c+1}{2b+c+1}$
$\log_{420}21$ = $\frac{2a-c+1}{2b+c+1}$

questions.question_text: The average marks of 5 students of a class is 57. The average marks of the top 3 students is 75. If the marks of the bottom 3 students are increased by 10, 4 and 9 in any order, the average of those 3 students increases by 25%. What was the third highest marks originally obtained?
questions.solution_text:
The sum of marks of all the students = 57*5 = 285
The sum of marks of top 3 students = 75*3=225
If the average increases by 25%, the sum of marks will also increase by 25%.
The increase in sum of the marks of bottom 3 students= 25% of x =  (10+4+9) = 23  where x is the sum of marks of bottom 3 students.
=> 25x/100=23   => x=92
The third highest marks = Sum of top 3 marks+ Sum of bottom 3 marks - Sum marks of all students = 225+92-285= 32

questions.question_text: If the difference between the simple interest and compound interest of the same rate of interest in the 2nd year is 625rupees. Find the percentage of rate of interest if the principle is 160000.
questions.solution_text:
Difference between S.I and C.I in 2nd year is $p\cdot\frac{r^2}{100}$.
given, $p\cdot\frac{r^2}{100}$= 625 => $r^2=\frac{625}{160000}=\left(\frac{25}{400}\right)^2$.
=> r=25/400.
Rate of interest=$\frac{25}{400}\cdot100=\frac{25}{4}=6.25\%^{ }$

questions.question_text: In an empty beer barrel of 25 litres there are two inlet pipes A and B. Pipe A will fill water in the barrel and Pipe B will fill alcohol solution of 80% concentration into the barrel. Pipe A and B can fill the barrel in 10 and 5 seconds respectively. How many seconds after pipe A is opened, should Pipe B be opened in order to make a beer barrel with 10% concentration?
questions.solution_text:
Final volume of alcohol in the barrel = 10%of 25= 2.5l
Flow in pipe A = 25/10=2.5 l /sec 
Flow in pipe B = 25/5= 5 l /sec 
Amount of Alcohol flow from pipe B= 80% of the flow=0.8x5=4 l /sec
Time for which Pipe B will work= 2.5 liters / 4 liters per sec= 5/8 sec
Suppose Pipe A will work for t sec.
Flow of water from Pipe A + Flow of solution from Pipe B=Volume of a barrel
2.5t + 5x5/8= 25 lt
t=70/8sec
So pipe A will start after 70/8-5/8 sec=65/8 sec.
